pages.text:
Contoso Properties LLC
Management Pack – Statement of Profit or Loss for the quarter ended 31 March 2026
Status: Final management pack (unaudited) Prepared: 14 April 2026 Currency: AED
AED Q1 2026
Revenue 5,240,000
Direct property costs (1,048,000)
Gross profit 4,192,000
Operating expenses (3,215,400)
Operating profit 976,600
Finance costs (273,000)
Profit before tax 703,600
Corporate tax (9%) (63,324)
Net profit for the period 640,276
Cash position
Closing cash at 31 March 2026 was AED 1,180,000, against a minimum operating cash requirement of AED
1,500,000, a shortfall of AED 320,000.
CFO commentary
The cash shortfall at the end of the quarter is mainly timing. Rent collections from two commercial tenants, totalling
AED 410,000, were received in the first week of April rather than in March. We also paid AED 260,000 of planned
maintenance on the Marina tower earlier than budgeted. We do not expect a shortfall at the end of the second
quarter, and no additional funding from the Group is requested at this stage.
– Chief Financial Officer, Contoso Properties LLC (fictional)
